scope: Applies only if the separately authorized v0.9 max-density synthetic Gate-D passes. This file does not authorize pixel acquisition, measurement, colour access, or empirical TTF inference.

measurement_contract.measurement_method_must_remain_unchanged: qualified ROI-v4 detector + EfficientSAM + fixed palette; no replacement after download or measurement failure

postmeasurement_support_gate.purpose: Prevent the premeasurement 100-record synthetic adequacy result from being applied to a sparser classifiable empirical geometry.
postmeasurement_support_gate.metadata_join: Join terminal status/classifiable only to the already frozen v0.9 reserve-B metadata coordinates. Colour values remain sealed.
postmeasurement_support_gate.consequence_for_exact_v09_panel: Because v0.9 contains exactly 250 species, every one of the 250 species must retain at least 40 classifiable records. Otherwise label the empirical TTF design not_evaluable; do not relax the threshold or replace species/photos.
postmeasurement_support_gate.species_split: Retain the same seed-20260920 125/125 species split; missing records may not move species between train and evaluation.
postmeasurement_support_gate.actual_geometry: Freeze the exact coordinates of classifiable terminal records only, with per-species counts and all missing/failure reasons, before any colour vector is accessible to TTF inference.

synthetic_requalification_on_actual_geom.inference: same profiled-private raw-transfer procedure as v0.8/v0.9

claim_boundary: A premeasurement synthetic adequacy pass is necessary but not sufficient for empirical TTF. Measurement attrition changes graph support and therefore must be requalified without colour values before empirical sharedness is tested.
